description: Replace Solana Trader's shared-cache-based token discovery (reads Base Trader's nansen_cache.json) with independent Nansen token-screener discovery. Each trader pays its own credits. Solana Trader calls POST /api/v1/token-screener directly for Solana chain discovery, then uses its own flow_intel_cache.json for per-token scoring.

userStories.title: Replace shared-cache read with independent Nansen token-screener call in Solana Trader
userStories.description:
Current state: load_candidate_tokens() in solana-trader/scripts/scanner.py reads from the shared Nansen cache at Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / 'shared' / 'nansen_cache.json'. This cache is written by Base Trader. When Base Trader is down (no credits), the cache goes stale and Solana Trader gets tokens_scanned=0.

What to build: Replace the shared-cache read with an independent Nansen token-screener API call for Solana chain.

New implementation of load_candidate_tokens():
1. Make a POST to https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/token-screener with body:
   {chains: ['solana'], timeframe: '24h', min_liquidity: 100000, min_market_cap: 5000000, max_market_cap: 500000000, min_token_age_days: 30, pagination: {limit: 10, page: 1}}
   Use the NANSEN_API_KEY from os.environ via _headers() (same headers as get_flow_intelligence)
2. Parse response: for each item extract token_address, token_symbol, chain, liquidity, market_cap_usd, netflow, price_usd, volume
3. Loop over pages 1-3 to collect up to 30 tokens (Nansen hard-caps at 10/page)
4. Filter: stablecoins from config (USDC, USDT, USDS), skip non-solana entries
5. Return list of dicts: [{symbol, address, chain='solana', liquidity_usd, market_cap_usd, price_usd, volume_usd, netflow_usd}]

Keep: sys.path.insert, json/requests imports, Path imports, get_flow_intelligence() unchanged.
Remove: SHARED_CACHE constant entirely.

Constraints:
- Keep get_flow_intelligence() unchanged -- it already uses Solana Trader's own flow_intel_cache.json
- Keep get_sol_price_usd() and get_btc_4h_change() unchanged
- Do NOT read from shared/nansen_cache.json or any file written by Base Trader
- Each pipeline run pays Nansen discovery credits for Solana independently
acceptanceCriteria: NANSEN_MOCK=1 python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/scripts'); from scanner import load_candidate_tokens; r=load_candidate_tokens({}); print(f'tokens={len(r)}')"
userStories.notes: Replaced shared Nansen cache read with independent token-screener API call in Solana Trader. Changes: removed SHARED_CACHE constant; load_candidate_tokens() now makes POST to https://api.nansen.ai/api
